---
title: "Niko"
format: html
include-in-header: 
  - text: |
      <style>figure { padding: 3em 0 3em 0; }</style
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load dataset
scores <- read_csv(file.path("..", "data", "scores.csv"))
player_name <- "niko"
player_scores <- scores %>% filter(player == player_name) %>% arrange(date)
```


## Stats Overview

```{r}
#| echo: false
tibble(
  "Total Rounds Played" = nrow(player_scores),
  "Highest Score" = max(player_scores$score),
  "Lowest Score" = min(player_scores$score),
  "Average Score" = mean(player_scores$score)
) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 1))) %>%
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(
      dom = "t",
      paging = FALSE,
      searching = FALSE,
      info = FALSE,
      lengthChange = FALSE
    )
  )
```

## Individual Results

```{r}
#| echo: false

daily_range <- player_scores %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin = min(score),
    ymax = max(score),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(player_scores, aes(x = date, y = score)) +
    geom_point(color = "darkred", size = 2) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = daily_range$date, date_labels = "%Y-%m-%d") +
    labs(title = paste("Individual Results per Day for", str_to_title(player_name)),
         x = "Date", y = "Score") +
    theme_minimal()
```


## Progression of Daily Averages


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

daily_avg <- player_scores %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(avg_score = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(daily_avg, aes(x = date, y = avg_score, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "darkred", linewidth = 3) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = daily_avg$date, date_labels = "%Y-%m-%d") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Progression of Daily Averages for", str_to_title(player_name)),
    x = "Date",
    y = "Average Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
